subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should the unified Usage & Spend experience remain a dedicated Settings sidebar pane, move into the existing Overview, or be deferred?
rationale: Both placements are technically viable and the contributor explicitly requested an owner decision; repository history and automated correctness review cannot determine the intended long-term information architecture.

options.title: Keep dedicated pane
options.body: Approve the focused Usage & Spend sidebar destination for persistent multi-provider history and detailed charts.

options.title: Integrate into Overview
options.body: Reuse the model but move the dashboard into the existing Overview to avoid adding another top-level Settings destination.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Pause or close the PR if a permanent aggregated-spend product surface is not wanted yet.

recommendation.title: Keep dedicated pane
recommendation.body: Approve the focused Usage & Spend sidebar destination for persistent multi-provider history and detailed charts.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the current rewrite and is the person directly asked to decide this placement.
